easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Lagrella until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
